## Constraints

### Must

- Dark UI: --background with --color-dark-100 and --color-dark-200 surfaces, --color-light-100 and --color-light-200 text, --primary as the one accent
- Status colors (--status-*, and amber, red and emerald) only for run outcomes, never as decoration
- Ask AI (app/ai) keeps ChatGPT's layout, chosen by the user on 2026-10-29: a chat sidebar, a mode switch above the chat, a centered new-chat screen, bubbles for questions and plain text for answers, a pill composer with a round send button, and icon-only answer actions, in the app's palette

### Avoid

- New UI libraries when the app's components or a native element (dialog, details) already do the job
